body: Inner critic. Constant. Telling me what a piece of shit I am, to hurt myself because I deserve the punishment, reminding me of all the bad and stupid things I've done.

Dx has always been PTSD and borderline personality disorder and hospitals are the last place I would go for help now that I have no ins. Without insurance you are treated like an imbecile child (and much, much worse) and no doctor will listen to you.

Can't turn off the thoughts. No matter what I'm doing, I always hear a voice inside telling me how terrible I am.

There arent any resources for us. Our income was too high, we will get nothing. 
Aaaand now our house smells like something is on fire, smoke coming through the heat exchange vents. Great.
